extractor_notes: Extracted 6 granted classes, matching INDEX.md's expected count for the 2006 cycle. All codified text for §201.40(b)(1)-(6) and the (c) definition is contained on PDF page 9 of the Final Rule (the .txt file has no [PAGE 10] marker; subsequent text is unrelated EPA rulemaking). The 2006 rule fuses permitted uses and limitations into single prose blocks per class; I decomposed each fused block into permitted_uses (affirmative scope) and exclusions (restrictions on who/how/when), with technical/term-of-art definitions placed in definitions_or_conditions. The (c) definition of 'specialized format,' 'digital text,' and 'authorized entities' (cross-referencing 17 U.S.C. 121) is incorporated into the definitions_or_conditions of class (b)(4), which is the class those defined terms apply to.

exemptions.equipment_or_work: Audiovisual works in college/university film or media studies library
permitted_uses: Circumvention to make compilations of portions of audiovisual works for educational use in the classroom by media studies or film professors
exclusions: Limited to audiovisual works included in the educational library of a college or university's film or media studies department
Limited to circumvention for the purpose of making compilations of portions of those works
Use must be educational and in the classroom
User must be a media studies or film professor

source.quote: (1) Audiovisual works included in the educational library of a college or university's film or media studies department, when circumvention is accomplished for the purpose of making compilations of portions of those works for educational use in the classroom by media studies or film professors.

exemptions.equipment_or_work: Obsolete computer programs and video games requiring original media or hardware
permitted_uses: Circumvention for the purpose of preservation or archival reproduction of published digital works by a library or archive
exclusions: Limited to computer programs and video games distributed in formats that have become obsolete
Limited to works that require the original media or hardware as a condition of access
Circumvention must be performed by a library or archive
Purpose must be preservation or archival reproduction of published digital works
definitions_or_conditions: A format shall be considered obsolete if the machine or system necessary to render perceptible a work stored in that format is no longer manufactured or is no longer reasonably available in the commercial marketplace

source.quote: (2) Computer programs and video games distributed in formats that have become obsolete and which require the original media or hardware as a condition of access, when circumvention is accomplished for the purpose of preservation or archival reproduction of published digital works by a library or archive. A format shall be considered obsolete if the machine or system necessary to render perceptible a work stored in that format is no longer manufactured or is no longer reasonably available in the commercial marketplace.

exemptions.equipment_or_work: Computer programs protected by obsolete malfunctioning dongles
permitted_uses: Circumvention of dongle protection on computer programs where the dongle prevents access due to malfunction or damage and is obsolete
exclusions: Limited to computer programs protected by dongles
The dongle must prevent access due to malfunction or damage
The dongle must be obsolete
definitions_or_conditions: A dongle shall be considered obsolete if it is no longer manufactured or if a replacement or repair is no longer reasonably available in the commercial marketplace

source.quote: (3) Computer programs protected by dongles that prevent access due to malfunction or damage and which are obsolete. A dongle shall be considered obsolete if it is no longer manufactured or if a replacement or repair is no longer reasonably available in the commercial marketplace.

exemptions.equipment_or_work: Literary works distributed in ebook format with disabled read-aloud or screen-reader access
permitted_uses: Circumvention of access controls on literary works distributed in ebook format to enable the book's read-aloud function or screen readers that render the text into a specialized format
exclusions: Limited to literary works distributed in ebook format

Exemption applies only when all existing ebook editions of the work (including digital text editions made available by authorized entities) contain access controls that prevent the enabling of either the read-aloud function or screen readers
definitions_or_conditions: 'Specialized format,' 'digital text' and 'authorized entities' shall have the same meaning as in 17 U.S.C. 121

source.quote: (4) Literary works distributed in ebook format when all existing ebook editions of the work (including digital text editions made available by authorized entities) contain access controls that prevent the enabling either of the book's read–aloud function or of screen readers that render the text into a specialized format.

exemptions.equipment_or_work: Firmware on wireless telephone handsets (cell phone unlocking)
permitted_uses: Circumvention of firmware that enables wireless telephone handsets to connect to a wireless telephone communication network, for the sole purpose of lawfully connecting to a wireless telephone communication network
exclusions: Limited to computer programs in the form of firmware
Limited to firmware that enables wireless telephone handsets to connect to a wireless telephone communication network
Circumvention must be for the sole purpose of lawfully connecting to a wireless telephone communication network

source.quote: (5) Computer programs in the form of firmware that enable wireless telephone handsets to connect to a wireless telephone communication network, when circumvention is accomplished for the sole purpose of lawfully connecting to a wireless telephone communication network.

exemptions.equipment_or_work: Sound recordings and associated audiovisual works on CDs with security-flawed protection (the 'Sony rootkit' exemption)
permitted_uses: Circumvention solely for the purpose of good faith testing, investigating, or correcting security flaws or vulnerabilities created or exploited by the technological protection measures
exclusions: Limited to sound recordings, and audiovisual works associated with those sound recordings, distributed in compact disc format
Limited to works protected by technological protection measures that control access to lawfully purchased works
Limited to TPMs that create or exploit security flaws or vulnerabilities that compromise the security of personal computers
Circumvention must be accomplished solely for good faith testing, investigating, or correcting such security flaws or vulnerabilities

source.quote: (6) Sound recordings, and audiovisual works associated with those sound recordings, distributed in compact disc format and protected by technological protection measures that control access to lawfully purchased works and create or exploit security flaws or vulnerabilities that compromise the security of personal computers, when circumvention is accomplished solely for the purpose of good faith testing, investigating, or correcting such security flaws or vulnerabilities.
